reference.source: Independent fresh standalone pages using unmodified official Ant Design/React UMD. Public ConfigProvider descriptors, natural popup contents, real pointer/editor/context/resize/scroll actions. No Native code, expected geometry math, or Source result corrections.
reference.defaults: Stable theme token.motion=false; transitionName and getPopupContainer omitted unless a case explicitly supplies a global container. Initial models are null for Select/TreeSelect, empty string for AutoComplete, empty array for Cascader.
reference.settle: Shared public driver moves the pointer outside after actions. Three identical complete projections, separated by two real paint frames and two tasks; consumer-owned actual head styles copied to an owned ShadowRoot.
reference.supplement: Public Pagination intrinsic-width counterparts; same IDs and actions as the immutable primary smoke pair.
reference.comparisonScope: Nested Select readers retain actual complete projections. Nonreader geometry is evidence for Source viewport/scroll pair inertness only; it does not establish new Native cross-framework geometry parity.
